title: 第十七章二转第十八章另寻出路
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 夜色浓重，废阁外山风呼啸。
叶凡坐在塌了一半的木板床上，面前的破桌上堆着一百五十多颗丹药。
药香浓郁得化不开，把屋里常年不散的霉味和焦臭味挤到了角落。
这堆丹药要是拿去黑市，能换回一笔让外门弟子眼红的灵石。
可叶凡连拿去换钱的念头都没动过。
存钱？
修仙界最不缺的就是有钱的死人。
资源摆在桌上，那是别人的；吃进肚子里，化作拳头上的力气，那才是自己的。
外门那些想踩着他去巴结内门赵师兄的家伙，随时会摸上山。
马得水那肥猪散布的消息，这会儿估计已经传遍了外门。
时间不等人。
叶凡没空去慢条斯理地炼化药力。
他伸出手，直接抓起一把锻体丹。
十来颗圆润饱满的丹药在掌心滚动，泛着微光。
寻常锻体境弟子，哪怕是到了八阶、九阶，吃这种一星提纯丹药，也得一颗一颗来，吃完还得打坐半天，生怕药力过猛撑坏了经脉。
叶凡咧了咧嘴。
“老子现在最不怕的就是撑。”
仰头，一把丹药尽数塞进嘴里。
嘎嘣。
嚼糖豆一样，直接咬碎吞下。
药力入腹。
没有温和的化开，也没有循序渐进的滋养。
一百多颗提纯丹药的底子，哪怕只是一小把，化作的灵气也堪称狂暴。
洪流。
纯粹的灵气洪流顺着经脉横冲直撞，完全不讲道理。
叶凡闷哼一声，脖子上的青筋根根暴起，像是一条条盘踞的青蛇。
太猛了。
他强行运转基础吐纳法，引导这股不受控制的洪流，朝着锻体八阶的关卡狠狠撞去。
经脉被撑得极度扩张，内壁传来不堪重负的酸胀感。
汗水刚从毛孔里渗出，就被体表急剧攀升的高温直接蒸发，化作丝丝缕缕的白雾。
破屋里的温度直线上升，宛如一个密不透风的蒸笼。
“给我开！”
叶凡咬紧牙关，在心里低吼。
体内传出沉闷的声响，像是一面破鼓被重锤敲击。
锻体八阶的壁垒，在狂暴的药力冲击下，连半个时辰都没撑住，直接宣告破碎。
灵气贯通，修为再上一层。
content_en:
The night is dark, and the mountain wind is howling outside the abandoned pavilion.
Ye Fan sat on the half-collapsed wooden bed, with more than 150 pills piled on the broken table in front of him.
The aroma of the medicine was so strong that it couldn't be dissipated, pushing the perennial musty and burnt smell in the room into the corner.
If this pile of elixirs were taken to the black market, they could be exchanged for a sum of spiritual stones that would make the outer disciples jealous.
But Ye Fan didn't even think about exchanging it for money.
Saving money?
The most indispensable thing in the world of immortality is rich dead people.
When resources are placed on the table, they belong to others; when they are eaten into the stomach and turned into strength in the fist, they belong to you.
Those guys from the outer sect who want to step on him to curry favor with Senior Brother Zhao from the inner sect will come up to the mountain at any time.
The news spread by Ma Deshui's fat pig has probably spread throughout the outer gates by now.
Time waits for no one.
Ye Fan had no time to refine the medicine slowly.
He stretched out his hand and grabbed a handful of body-building pills.
A dozen round and plump elixirs rolled in the palm of his hand, glowing slightly.
Ordinary Body Training Realm disciples, even if they reach the eighth or ninth level, have to take this kind of one-star purified elixir one by one, and have to meditate for a long time after eating it, for fear that the medicine is too strong and will damage the meridians.
Ye Fan grinned.
"The thing I'm not afraid of the most right now is holding on."
He raised his head and stuffed a handful of pills into his mouth.
Bang.
Like chewing jelly beans, just bite them into pieces and swallow them.
The medicine enters the abdomen.
There is no gentle dissolution and no gradual nourishment.
The foundation of more than a hundred purified elixirs, even a small handful, can turn into aura that can be described as violent.
torrent.
The torrent of pure spiritual energy rushes along the meridians, completely unreasonable.
Ye Fan groaned, and the veins on his neck popped out, like coiled green snakes.
Too fierce.
He forcibly operated the basic breathing method, guiding this uncontrolled torrent towards the eighth level of body training.
The meridians were stretched to the extreme, and there was an overwhelming sense of soreness and swelling in the inner walls.
As soon as the sweat seeped out of the pores, it was directly evaporated by the sharply rising high temperature on the body surface, turning into wisps of white mist.
The temperature in the broken house rose sharply, like an airtight steamer.
"Open it for me!"
Ye Fan gritted his teeth and growled in his heart.
There was a dull sound coming from the body, like a broken drum being struck with a heavy hammer.
The barrier of the eighth-level body forging, under the violent impact of the medicine, did not even hold up for half an hour and was immediately shattered.
The spiritual energy is penetrated, and the cultivation level reaches another level.
